intro: Norso chair adds a touch of nature indoors. Its earthy hue, cushioned comfort, and simple form make it the chair you’ll turn to for both casual dining and peaceful pauses.

features.title: Forest green for natural calm
features.text: Bring the outdoors in with this rich green tone, instantly refreshing your room with earthy, grounding vibes.

features.title: Plush cushioning that embraces you
features.text: Soft padding makes every sit a comfort, letting you linger longer at the table or enjoy a quiet tea break.

features.title: Minimal design for versatile use
features.text: The clean, straightforward design adapts seamlessly to dining rooms, studies, or accent seating corners.

features.title: Durable fabric that stays fresh
features.text: Resists everyday wear while keeping a smooth touch, making it reliable for frequent use without losing appeal.

features.title: Light build for flexible placement
features.text: Easy to carry and move, this chair lets you adjust layouts or add extra seating when guests arrive.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
